reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Christine Marie
reviews.text: Amazing work!! I got a full paint on my old baby and now she looks brand new again! I received updates throughout the process and the price was very reasonable. I highly recommend J&D Holton Automotive and would work with them again as needed!

reviews.author: Randy Steffey
reviews.text: Contacted Jason about a door ding repair. He was super responsive and easy to schedule with. The repair is flawless and the paint match is perfect. Highly recommend anyone needing automotive paint work done to contact him.

reviews.author: Cassandra McLean
reviews.text: I dropped my truck off looking like it had survived a hurricane, two elk mating season attacks, and a shopping cart ambush. When I picked it up, I almost walked past it because it looked too good to be mine. The paint job is flawless, smooth, shiny, and downright sexy. If my truck had a dating profile now, it would have more of a social life than me! Huge shout out to Jason -If Michelangelo had a spray gun! 10/10 would let these paint wizards work their magic again.

reviews.author: Billy Knapp
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience at J & D Holton Automotive from start to finish. Jason was professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about doing the job right. He was very good with communicating. He took the time to explain the repairs, gave an accurate timeline, and kept me updated throughout the process. The quality of work was exceptional, my Jeep looks as good as new. Everything was completed on time. Jason paid attention to every detail and made sure it was flawless before turning it back over to us. I highly recommend J & D Holton Automotive to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality auto body repair. I wouldn’t hesitate to come back again!

reviews.author: Jaquail Rountree
reviews.text: Excellent experience, Highly Recommend!!! I hit a deer traveling home from work. Called my insurance company they had a adjuster come out and wrote out a check and Jason started on my car the next day and texted me frequently to update me on the progress. When I picked up my car about a week later it was detailed and spotless and they matched the paint perfectly. I would strongly recommend J&D holton automotive if you want great paint & body work and excellent customer service. Thanks again, Jason

reviews.author: Allison Jones
reviews.text: Excellent customer service and outstanding workmanship. Jason Holton has always has gone above and beyond for all of our body shops repair needs. We have used him for years and would highly recommend his services to our friends and family.

reviews.author: Evan Hamner
reviews.text: Jason did an amazing job repairing are Toyota Tacoma! Not only did he do amazing, timely, and quality work. But he helped fight are case with the insurance company to get the repairs covered by our insurance company. As soon as he got the vehicle he immediately started the claim process with are insurance company by submitting the needed pictures and documentation. Jason also kept us up to date on any delays and with insurance process or getting parts in. We where so impressed happy we chose Jason for are repairs we will use him agian if we have any more collisions. Thanks for a great job Jason!! - Evan and Jennifer H.

reviews.author: Beth Ann Haynes
reviews.text: What an amazing job. The car looks brand new and the color match impeccable. It was an extremely stressful experience and it was well worth the wait to see the end results. We will refer anyone to you and come back to you if we need any rebuilt or repairs done !

reviews.author: Jimmie Hopkins
reviews.text: Jason has repaired, restored, customized and modified multiple different vehicles for me over the past 40 years. I am so thankful to know someone that has the work ethic to do things the right way. I Will Not trust Any other company to do what he does. The latest is my 1980 Camaro Z28

reviews.author: Sean Irvin
reviews.text: Quality American shop located in Camden! Great service and the end result was spectacular! I get compliments on my car all the time

reviews.author: Ray Urban
reviews.text: The team did an amazing job, very pleased with the results. Body work and paint are flawless, mirror image with great colors. Professional and quick turn around, highly recommended. Thanks

reviews.author: Troy Brickhouse
reviews.text: The absolute best customer service. Jason is very knowledgeable of the automotive industry and will have your ride better than new. Will also battle insurance for you. Paint is flawless. You won’t find a better body shop. The quality of work and customer service is outstanding. Highly recommend and will definitely be back

reviews.author: Heys McMath
reviews.text: Great service, fair prices and he isn’t in it to oversell you on new parts. Can’t ask for much more. Will use them again if and when we need body work and painting.

reviews.author: Alphonso Mebane
reviews.text: I go to J & D Holton body shop for all of my auto repair work. This shop does excellent work and it give you great quality. The body and paint work is perfect and his professionalism is even better. The prices are very good and he works with you on parts cost. I recommend this shop to all my family and friends. Don't miss out on a great auto repair shop for your car or truck.

reviews.author: Tammy Givens
reviews.text: Someone hit my car in a parking lot, and by the time they were finished with the repairs, you couldn’t even tell anything had happened. Very professional service, excellent communication, and truly quality work.

reviews.author: Carol Ankrum
reviews.text: This is the 2nd automobile mishap Jason at J&D Automotive has fixed for me. He does quality work, is easy to work with, will fight with insurance and is just an all around good guy. I have referred 2 other people in the past week. I wouldn’t recommend a business I wasn’t completely satisfied with.

reviews.author: Sarah Saunders
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the service I received. They were very professional and honest. They communicated with insurance company so I didn’t have to do anything but pick up my car. My car was repaired and looks just like new. I highly recommend this business for your repair needs!

reviews.author: Doug Brickhouse
reviews.text: Jason is the best body and paint man in all of eastern North Carolina, hands down. If for any reason you are not satisfied he will make it right. Awesome experience with this business.

reviews.author: Tim Phelps
reviews.text: Jason helped restore a 69 Plymouth for me. His workmanship is "Outstanding" to say the least. It is True you get what you pay for. It takes time/effort/money and patience when restoring "Old Cars". Jason is the Best !!

reviews.author: Ken Watts
reviews.text: Excellent work, great people. Truck was damaged by a bear, repaired better than new, all damaged parts replaced. Worked with insurance and everything was covered. Definitely recommended.

reviews.author: Karen Bissinger
reviews.text: Jason was very helpful in getting our company van back up and running after hitting a deer. Was updated with photos as work was done. Easy to work with since our office is 5 hours away

reviews.author: Kellie Cartier
reviews.text: Had a great experience working with Jason. He got our truck in and repaired quickly and for a great price! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: C. Scott Dashiell
reviews.text: I have used Jason for years. My clients have been extremely pleased with his work. C. Scott Dashiell Agency Owner. Allstate Insurance

reviews.author: Todd Smith
reviews.text: Excellent repair job. Paint on repair was perfectly matched to original paint. Fast service & friendly people. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Bartholomew Weinershztitzkel
reviews.text: They did a great job fixing rear-end damage, were reasonable and easy to deal with. I will consider this place first before anyone else.

reviews.author: ray miller
reviews.text: Took my camry to jason after running my truck down the side of it and it looks better than when it was new! The best body man around!

reviews.author: Randy Krainiak
reviews.text: I don't believe our can get a better paint and or repair anywhere else. I've used Hortons 20 years ago and will continue

reviews.author: Keelmoney Boii
reviews.text: Very top notch quality work. Will have everything just how you like it from custom work to oem best in the business that I know.
